pūrvārdhe śrīrāmasamādhipradarśanavyājenottamādhikāriṇaḥ
śravaṇāvṛttiparipākādeva sākṣātkārajñānodayena paramapade
sakṛdviśrāntirbhavatīti darśitam

tasya daivātpunarvyutthāne'pi yathā avirataṃ tatraiva
viśrāntiranāyāsena sidhyati tathottarottarabhūmikāropaṇāyottarārdhamidamārabhyate
atrādau rāmaḥ ahaṃmameti saṃvidanna duḥkhato vimucyate

ityante yaduktaṃ tatra sarvakalpanātyāge
kalpanādhīnadehadhāraṇādivyavahārāsiddhiṃ śaṅkate - naiṣkarmyāditi

na kalpanādhīnaṃ jīvanaṃ yena tattyāgāttanupātaḥ syāt kiṃtu bhojakaprārabdhādhīnam
kalpanātyāga eva pratyuta jīvanādhīnajanmeti nopajīvanaṃ bādhata ityaviruddhaṃ
kiṃtvajīvanameva virudhyata ityāśayena bhagavānvasiṣṭhaḥ samādhatte - jīvata iti

asya kalpanātyāgasya svarūpaṃ yathā jīvanaviruddhaṃ na bhavati tathā mayā yathātattvaṃ
varṇyamānaṃ śṛṇvityarthaḥ
idaṃ dehādi sarvaṃ dṛśyaṃ vastu paramārthasatyamiti saṃvegamabhimānam

tasya
nabhaḥkāryabhūtacatuṣṭayavikāratvāttattvato nabhortha evaikaḥ sphuratītyarthasya
bhāvanaṃ paryālocanam

smṛtiṃ smaraṇaṃ sarvamanumityādivṛttyantaraṃ ca vismṛtya
aparicchinnabrahmākāranilīnaḥ kāṣṭhavaddṛḍho niśralaśca tiṣṭha ciraṃ jīva

tathā ca
brahmātmabhāvena cittavṛttinirodho yogināmāyurvṛddhyā pratyuta jīvanahetureveti
bhāvaḥ
vyavahārakāle tu smṛtimātranirodhaḥ kārya ityāha - sarveti

vināprayojanoddeśaṃ pūrvasaṃskāramātreṇa kṛtakāryaṃ kulālacakraṃ yathā
yāvadvegakṣayaṃ praspandate bhramati tathetyarthaḥ

sattvaṃ nirvāsanaṃ manastadīyaṃ saṃskāravegamāgato'nugataḥ san
rāgādidoṣakṣayānnocchṛṅkhalapravṛttiprasaktirityāśayenāha - pravāheti

evaṃ praśnaṃ samādhāya bahukṛtvo'pi pathyaṃn vaditavyamiti nyāyena prāguktameva
saṃkalpatyāgādi śreyaḥsādhanamityudghoṣayanpunaḥpunarāha -
ūrdhvabāhurityādinā

prāktanasaṃkalpaprayuktakriyāvegavaśādeva yāvattatkṣayaṃ vyavahārasiddhau
prāguktaṃ dṛṣṭāntāntaraṃ punarāha - gamyeti

yathā svataśceṣṭitonmuktaṃ śaṣpaṃ bālatṛṇaṃ vāyvādipravāhapatite
tṛṇāntarasaṃyogaviyogādikārye spandate tadvat

yathā pareṣāṃ kautukārthaṃ nṛtyādi kurvata iva sthitasya dāruputrikāyantrasya
naṭavacchṛṅgārādirasabhāvanaṃ nāsti tadvattavāpi kurvato viṣayasukhe mūrkhasyeva
rasabhāvanaṃ kautukabuddhirmā bhūdityarthaḥ

vallyā veṣṭitaḥ śiśire druma
iva nīrasaḥ
nanu nīrasasya ṣaḍvargasya kathaṃ jīvanaṃ tatrāha - ciditi

anāvaraṇabhūmānandarūpā cidevāntaro jīvanapuṣṭyādiheturaso yeṣāṃ tāni pravṛttāni
svabhāvādbāhyarasāsvāde pravṛttānyapi khayatnena nivārya cidāntararasānyeva
kṛtvā dhārayetyarthaḥ

yathā hemantartustarūn
bāhyajalābhāve'pyāntareṇaiva rasena jīvayati tadvadityarthaḥ
indriyavṛttīnāmanivāraṇe sarasatve ca kiṃ syāttatrāha - saraseti
niḥsaṃkalpameva maruto jvālāyā yantrasyāmbunaśca yathā spandastathā yadi spandase

cakre bhramatīti bhrama ābhogaḥ saṃniveśa iva śanairuttarottaramupaśamaśīlaḥ
spandasva

phalāsaṅgābhāve karmakaraṇe tattyāge ca na
viśeṣa ityāśayenāha - ubhayamiti

nispandaṃ tūṣṇīmavasthānamāmavātajaḍīkṛtasarvāṅgasyeva khedāyaiveti śaṅkāṃ
vārayati - same iti

kṛtena akṛtena vā laukikavaidikakarmaṇā jīvata aihiko'jīvata āmuṣmiko'pyarthaḥ
puruṣārtho nāsti

yasya karmakartṛtādau
satyatābuddhistasyaiva karmaphalamiti śraddhādivadadhikāriviśeṣaṇavidhāyakaśāstreṇa
bodhanāditi bhāvaḥ

ata eva dehādāvahaṃmameti saṃvedanavata eva vidhiniṣedhaśāstrādhikārātkarmakṛto
bandho netarasyeti prāguktamityāha - ahaṃmameti
